1.title: Where Is the U.S. Beating China on A.I., and Where Is It Lagging?
1.summary: As Xi Jinping visits President Trump in Washington, his country lags behind the United States on A.I. development in key areas — but Beijing has advantages elsewhere.

2.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault
2.summary: Assault survivor Miriam Haley said the "devastating effect on my life and sense of security that may never go away".

3.title: Officials Investigating Mississippi Student Deaths Issue Warning About Kratom
3.summary: The herbal substance Kratom was found during inquiries into the recent deaths of two University of Mississippi students. Their causes of death have not been determined.

4.title: U.N. Live Updates: Zelensky Warns Russian Aggression May Spread Beyond Ukraine
4.summary: The Ukrainian president called for new sanctions targeting Russian finances and steps to end the war before it entered another winter. Earlier, President Masoud Pezeshkian of Iran said his country would not be bullied by the United States.

6.title: Ancient Wall Found in Paris Provides Clues to City’s Origins
6.summary: A discovery at a Parisian hospital, on an island in the Seine, has given archaeologists clues about the city as Julius Caesar may have found it.
